selection.edition: international Cardly API v2 (Composio CARDLY HTTP tools)
selection.ownership: Cardly (Patrick Gaskin), Sunshine Coast, Australia. International handwritten-card API at api.card.ly with production sites in AU/US/UK/CA.

research.searchCoverage: Official Cardly OpenAPI 2.2.0 (API-Key header, GET /account/balance, /media, /fonts, /writing-styles), Australian Cardly identity, and dated incident search (Cardly + card.ly + security breach/incident) reviewed on 2026-09-13. No qualifying current unresolved Cardly compromise found after distinguishing unrelated Australian card-data and greeting-card hits. Not a breach-free claim.

Official Cardly v2 REST authenticates with the API-Key header on https://api.card.ly/v2. GET /account/balance is the documented remaining-credit probe used by the pinned validator and is used as healthcheck rather than a billable order/search. GET /media, /fonts, and /writing-styles are documented catalog reads. Operator is Cardly, Sunshine Coast, Australia; international product printed from AU/US/UK/CA. Dated incident search on 2026-09-13 found no qualifying current unresolved Cardly compromise. Composio CARDLY tools (29) mapped onto official OpenAPI 2.2.0 paths for contact lists, invitations, users, webhooks, artwork, orders, templates, doodles, credit history, and echo.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.
